question: Which of the following states of India marked the lowest in National Multi-dimensional Poverty Index: A Progress Review 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kerala recorded the **lowest multi-dimensional poverty index (MPI)** among all Indian states in the **National Multi-dimensional Poverty Index: A Progress Review 2023**.
 
• Only **0.7%** of Kerala's population was classified as multi-dimensionally poor, making it the best-performing state in this metric.
 
• The report, based on data from the **National Family Health Survey-5 (2019-2021)**, highlights Kerala's strong performance in health, education, and living standards.
 
• Kerala's achievements are attributed to its focus on **universal education, healthcare, and social welfare programs** over several decades.
 
• The state’s consistent investment in **human development** has enabled it to achieve low poverty levels compared to other states in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI)**

 
 
• India's MPI is aligned with the global MPI developed by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)** and the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI).
 
• The MPI measures poverty across three dimensions: **health, education, and living standards**, which are further divided into 12 indicators.
 
• Unlike income-based poverty measures, MPI captures the multiple deprivations that individuals face.
 
 
 
• **Kerala's Human Development Model**
 
 
• Kerala is known for its **high literacy rate** (96.2% as per NFHS-5) and excellent public health indicators.
 
• The state has a strong network of public healthcare facilities and a focus on **primary education**.
 
• Social welfare programs, such as pensions for the elderly and marginalized groups, have significantly reduced poverty levels.
 
 
 
• **Other High-Performing States**
 
 
• States such as **Goa** and **Sikkim** also performed well, with relatively low levels of multi-dimensional poverty.
 
• These states have prioritized investments in education, healthcare, and infrastructure, contributing to better living standards.
 
 
 
• **Significance of MPI**
 
 
• The MPI provides a more comprehensive picture of poverty compared to traditional income-based measures.
 
• It helps policymakers identify areas that require targeted interventions for **poverty alleviation**.
 
• The data can also be used to track progress towards achieving the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, particularly SDG-1 (No Poverty).
